title: Incremental Roseland: Batch-wise Landmark Diffusion via Kernelized Sequential Karhunen--Lo\`eve Update
abstract: arXiv:2611.23414v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Landmark diffusion (Roseland) computes a diffusion-map-style spectral embedding from the singular value decomposition of a degree-normalized data-to-landmark kernel matrix, at a cost far below that of full diffusion maps. It assumes, however, that all data are available at once. We introduce incremental Roseland (iRoseland), which casts the landmark affinity as a row-growing matrix whose SVD can be updated with a kernelized Sequential Karhunen--Lo\`eve (SKL) scheme. Degre correction is handled by a first order expansion about a reference mean kernel row and so that the landmark-side eigenbasis may be recovered from a single landmark-by-landmark eigendecomposition at each step. The presented method requires only a single pass over the data and runs in bounded-memory with state independent of the number of points processed. A forgetting factor lets the method track drifting distributions, and a sample-size-invariant embedding keeps outputs

translated_title: 增量式Roseland：基于核化序贯Karhunen–Loève更新的分批地标扩散
translated_abstract: 地标扩散从度归一化的数据-地标核矩阵的奇异值分解中计算扩散映射式的谱嵌入，其代价远低于完整扩散映射。然而，该方法假设所有数据是同时一次性可用的。我们提出增量式Roseland（iRoseland），将地标亲和度视为一个行数不断增长的矩阵，其奇异值分解可以通过核化的序贯Karhunen–Loève（SKL）方案进行更新。度校正通过围绕参考平均核行的一阶展开来处理，从而使得地标侧的特征基可以在每一步通过单次地标间的特征分解得以恢复。所提出的方法只需对数据进行一次遍历，并在有界内存下运行，其状态与已处理的数据点数量无关。引入遗忘因子使该方法能够跟踪漂移的分布，且样本量不变的嵌入可保持输出的一致性。
tldr: 提出增量式Roseland（iRoseland），通过核化序贯Karhunen–Loève方案对流式增长的地标亲和矩阵的SVD进行增量更新，实现仅需单次数据遍历、有界内存、并可跟踪分布漂移的地标扩散谱嵌入。
en_tdlr: iRoseland enables batch-wise landmark diffusion spectral embedding by incrementally updating the SVD of a row-growing landmark affinity matrix via a kernelized Sequential Karhunen–Loève scheme, achieving single-pass, bounded-memory computation with distribution drift tracking.
